evals.prompt: Create generic notebook for OperationalExpenseInvoiceFlattened silver to gold using the STTM in Output/STTM_DDL_creation/
evals.expected_output: A .py file in Output/CodeGeneration/ with a 10-section structure, Upsert strategy (MERGE INTO on InvoiceSourceName), no PepsiCo framework imports, and a Delta audit table write.

assertions.text: Output file exists at Output/CodeGeneration/ with a name matching the table and source layer
Notebook contains MAGIC %md header cell with project name, purpose, source/target, and load strategy
Imports block contains only stdlib and PySpark imports — no cdo_audit_framework_wd_la or cdo_dq_framework
Notebook declares exactly 4 widgets: job_id, run_id, pipeline_name, run_ts — each with an or-fallback default
Variable block contains INPUT_TABLES, GOLD_DB, MERGE_KEYS, LOAD_STRATEGY
Source tables are read via spark.table() and registered as temp views via createOrReplaceTempView()
Transformation SQL uses STTM column mappings with explicit CAST and AS aliases — no SELECT *
SELECT contains mandatory audit columns: XTNCreatedTime, XTNCreatedById, XTNUpdatedTime, XTNUpdatedById
Write logic uses DeltaTable.merge with MERGE_KEYS — Upsert strategy detected from STTM
Audit row written via spark.createDataFrame(audit_row, schema) with explicit DDL schema string and .write.format('delta').mode('append').saveAsTable(AUDIT_TABLE)
Audit write is wrapped in its own try/except and does NOT set status = 'Failed' on exception
Notebook ends with dbutils.notebook.exit() on success and raise Exception on failure
No display(), show(), or count() calls anywhere in the notebook
No %run ./notebook_common_utils or %run ./notebook_common_variables in the notebook

evals.prompt: Build a simple etl notebook for a table with no merge keys — should use Append strategy
evals.expected_output: A .py notebook using df_final.write.format('delta').mode('append').saveAsTable(full_target) instead of DeltaTable.merge, with MERGE_KEYS as an empty list, all 10 sections intact, and a Delta audit write.

assertions.text: MERGE_KEYS is set to an empty list []
LOAD_STRATEGY is set to 'append'
Write logic uses .write.format('delta').mode('append') — no DeltaTable.merge call
All 10 notebook sections (header, imports, widgets, variables, read, transform, write, audit, exit) are present
Mandatory XTN audit columns still appear in the SELECT
No cdo_audit_framework_wd_la or cdo_dq_framework imports

evals.prompt: Generate a standalone notebook for a full-reload table — delete existing data for SystemId then insert fresh
evals.expected_output: A .py notebook with LOAD_STRATEGY='delete-insert', containing a spark.sql DELETE WHERE XTNDFSystemId = {SYSTEM_ID} statement followed by .write.format('delta').mode('append'), with all standard sections and Delta audit write intact.

assertions.text: LOAD_STRATEGY is set to 'delete-insert'
Write section contains TRUNCATE TABLE statement followed by .write.format('delta').mode('append')
DELETE is followed by .write.format('delta').mode('append') — not MERGE INTO
Audit row is written to audit_table after the delete-insert completes
Unity Catalog three-part names (catalog.schema.table) used for all table references
No %run utility notebooks present
